checks.detail: All six common headers are identical. Common inputs contain only the shared task/output instruction, common platform declaration, the case workload and line-numbered full source. Current output instruction is plain Chinese Markdown in both arms.

All 27 source bodies reconstructed from line-numbered common inputs match the former frozen source byte-for-byte and match embedded/run-plan hashes. Six workloads differ only by removal of the original SDK-guide paragraph.

All 12 A prompt hashes match their common input. All 12 B prompt hashes match exactly common input plus inputs/skill-suffix.txt. There are precisely two runs for each case/arm and one for each case/arm/repeat triple.

The suffix contains SKILL.md and all five reference bodies, each exactly once and matching frozen file hashes, plus filename/title/newline wrappers only. No source archive, raw SDK manual corpus, gold JSON, grader text or per-case reference choice is appended.

The inline skill uses general Add and basic Cube teaching examples, distinct from the evaluated exp/maximum/copy/fused/high-performance source fixtures. No CUxx gold IDs or case-specific 25019/8340/renamed-entry answer material appears. This supports absence of direct payload leakage, subject to the documented provenance limitation.

The former freeze hash matches the declared gold freeze, all six gold files remain unchanged, and 59 facts retain algorithm_strategy/execution/hardware at 10 each, 30 per case and 180 per full six-case repeat. Explicit error caps are unchanged and omission does not trigger them.

GRADING_PROTOCOL predeclares concrete expressions with unambiguous units and ranges as semantic equivalents of final numbers. This preserves the fixed facts and avoids penalizing formula versus decimal/list formatting. It does not excuse generic formulas lacking workload values or an unknown unit/range, and creates no new cap.

Unknown, partial, explicit wrong and unsupported claims remain distinct. Existing UnitFlag protocol recognition and bounded SDK/default-state reservations can coexist; absence of M_FIX alone does not prove a bug, and a documented limitation is not a measured device failure.

Transport/client configuration, the server metadata and smoke output were not independently inspected. The current protocol states one direct Responses request with tools=[] and tool_choice=none; root is separately responsible for validating and retaining that evidence. No subject or grading calls were made in this review.

limitations.detail: This compares no skill against the full expanded skill package: reading method, architecture/API knowledge, examples and extra context. It cannot isolate method-only benefit, nor deployment with only a short entry and unavailable references. The 29991-character fixed suffix and token/time cost are part of the intervention.

limitations.topic: External validity and prior development exposure
limitations.detail: The six fixtures reuse the known source/gold suite and case-06 structurally reuses case-01/case-04 computations. Tutorial examples share the same API family. Static input review finds no case-dependent selection or direct gold payload, but does not establish a held-out generalization result or prove the skill author never saw benchmark design.

Two fresh-context repeats per arm and case support a descriptive matched comparison. Repeats and the renamed case are not independent new tasks; do not present all 24 answers as 24 independent task samples or claim broad statistical significance from them.

limitations.topic: Fixed hardware standard without subject manuals
limitations.detail: The retained 59 facts include API/platform knowledge as well as source derivations. Subjects may use prior knowledge and B may use its fixed skill knowledge. A correct specific knowledge claim need not include an inaccessible manual quote; lack of supplied manuals does not justify adding a new cap or replacing concrete source facts with blanket uncertainty. Differences therefore include knowledge support.

No compile, device run, exact numerical bits or performance result is established. Differences from an earlier tool/SDK-enabled round cannot be interpreted as a causal tool benefit because multiple context and execution conditions changed.
